title: Grade 5 French — Wed, May 20
description: Months & Seasons (Les Mois et les Saisons) — Last Week Day 3
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'January' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Janvier' = January. French months are not capitalised: janvier, février, mars...

questions.question: What is 'March' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mars' = March. Note: This is also the name of the planet Mars in French!

questions.question: In which month is Christmas (Noël) celebrated?
questions.explanation: 'Décembre' = December. 'Noël' (Christmas) is celebrated on December 25th — le 25 décembre.

questions.question: What is the French word for 'spring'?
questions.explanation: 'Le printemps' = spring. Été = summer, Automne = autumn/fall, Hiver = winter.

questions.question: Which season is 'l'hiver'?
questions.explanation: 'L'hiver' = winter. It is the coldest season — en hiver (in winter).

questions.question: How do you say 'In summer, it is hot' in French?
questions.explanation: 'En été, il fait chaud' = 'In summer, it is hot'. 'Il fait chaud' = it is hot (weather expression).

questions.question: How do you say 'My birthday is in May' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mon anniversaire est en mai' = 'My birthday is in May'. 'En' is used before months.

questions.question: Which French month corresponds to September?
questions.explanation: 'Septembre' = September. The months July–December: juillet, août, septembre, octobre, novembre, décembre.

questions.question: What is 'l'automne'?
questions.explanation: 'L'automne' = autumn/fall. It is the season of falling leaves — en automne (in autumn).

questions.question: In French, months are written:
options: Only with capital letters at start of sentence
questions.explanation: In French, months are NOT capitalised: janvier, février, mars... (unlike English: January, February, March).

questions.question: How do you ask 'What is the date today?' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Quelle est la date aujourd'hui?' = 'What is the date today?' Another form: 'On est le combien aujourd'hui?'

questions.question: Which preposition is used before months in French? (e.g., 'in May')
questions.explanation: 'En' is used before months: en janvier (in January), en mai (in May), en décembre (in December).

questions.question: How do you say 'the 14th of July' (Bastille Day) in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le quatorze juillet' = 14th July (Bastille Day — French National Day). Dates: le + number + month.

questions.question: What weather expression means 'It is snowing'?
questions.explanation: 'Il neige' = It is snowing. Il pleut = It is raining, Il fait chaud = It is hot, Il fait froid = It is cold.

questions.question: Which months belong to 'l'été' (summer) in France?
questions.explanation: Summer (l'été) in France: juin (June), juillet (July), août (August). School summer holidays are in July–August.
